Chapter 4 Histograms

4.1 Metagenomics

load("resources/metagenomics/data_filtered.Rdata")
genome_counts_filt %>%
  mutate(across(-genome, ~ . / sum(.))) %>%          # normalize each genome
  column_to_rownames("genome") %>%
  t() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample") %>%
  select(-sample) %>%                      # remove grouping info
  summarise(across(everything(), mean, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%  # mean across all samples
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "Genome",
    values_to = "MeanValue"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(MeanValue)) %>% 
  ggplot(., aes(x = reorder(Genome, -MeanValue), y = MeanValue)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "MAGs",
    y = "Mean Value",
    title = "Overall Mean Genome Abundance (All Samples Combined)"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45, hjust=1, size = 8),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_line(size = 0.5, linetype = "solid", colour = "black"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 18))

genome_counts_filt %>%
  mutate(across(-genome, ~ . / sum(.))) %>%
  column_to_rownames(., "genome") %>% 
  t() %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column(., "sample") %>% 
  left_join(sample_metadata[c(1, 2)], by="sample") %>% 
  select(-sample) %>% 
  group_by(Species) %>% 
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), mean, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Species,                # all columns except Species
    names_to = "Genome",            # column names become a variable
    values_to = "MeanValue"         # cell values become this variable
  ) %>%
  group_by(Genome) %>%
  mutate(overall_mean = mean(MeanValue, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Genome = fct_reorder(Genome, overall_mean, .desc = TRUE)) %>% 
  ggplot(., aes(x = Genome, y = MeanValue, fill = Species)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") + 
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "Genome",
    y = "Mean Value",
    fill = "Species",
    title = "Mean Genome Abundance per Species"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_line(size = 0.5, linetype = "solid", colour = "black"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 18))

presence_threshold <- 0  # define what counts as "present"

genome_counts_filt %>%
  mutate(across(-genome, ~ . / sum(.))) %>%
  column_to_rownames("genome") %>%
  t() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample") %>%
  left_join(sample_metadata[c("sample", "Species")], by = "sample") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(sample, Species),
    names_to = "Genome",
    values_to = "RelAbundance"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Genome) %>%
  summarise(
    MeanAbundance = mean(RelAbundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    Prevalence = sum(RelAbundance > presence_threshold, na.rm = TRUE),
    FractionPrevalence = Prevalence / n(),  # optional normalized prevalence
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  ggplot(., aes(x = fct_reorder(Genome, -MeanAbundance), y = MeanAbundance, fill = Prevalence)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "MAGs",
    y = "Mean relative abundance",
    fill = "Prevalence",
    title = "Mean MAG relative abundance colored by prevalence"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_line(size = 0.5, linetype = "solid", colour = "black"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12))

presence_threshold <- 0  # define what counts as "present"

genome_summary_abs <- genome_counts_filt %>%
  column_to_rownames("genome") %>%
  t() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample") %>%
  left_join(sample_metadata[c("sample", "Species")], by = "sample") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(sample, Species),
    names_to = "Genome",
    values_to = "AbsCount"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Genome) %>%
  summarise(
    MeanAbsCount = mean(AbsCount, na.rm = TRUE),
    Prevalence = sum(AbsCount > presence_threshold, na.rm = TRUE),
    FractionPrevalence = Prevalence / n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(LogMeanAbsCount = log10(MeanAbsCount + 1)) 
ggplot(genome_summary_abs, aes(
  x = fct_reorder(Genome, MeanAbsCount, .desc = TRUE),
  y = LogMeanAbsCount,
  fill = FractionPrevalence
)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "turbo", limits = c(0, 1)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "MAGs",
    y = "log10",
    fill = "Prevalence",
    title = "Mean MAG Abundance (Absolute Counts, log-transformed) Colored by Prevalence"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_line(size = 0.5, linetype = "solid", colour = "black"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12))

presence_threshold <- 0
genome_prevalence_counts <- genome_counts_filt %>%
  mutate(across(-genome, ~ . / sum(.))) %>%              # normalize within genome if needed
  column_to_rownames("genome") %>%
  t() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample") %>%
  left_join(sample_metadata[c("sample", "Species")], by = "sample") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(sample, Species),
    names_to = "Genome",
    values_to = "RelAbundance"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Genome) %>%
  summarise(
    Prevalence = sum(RelAbundance > presence_threshold, na.rm = TRUE),  # count of samples
    TotalSamples = n(),                                                  # total samples in that species
    Fraction = Prevalence / TotalSamples,                                # optional: proportion
    .groups = "drop"
  )
ggplot(genome_prevalence_counts, aes(x = reorder(Genome, -Prevalence), y = Prevalence)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "MAGs",
    y = "Prevalence",
    title = "MAGs Prevalence Within Each Species"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_line(size = 0.5, linetype = "solid", colour = "black"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12))

        axis.line = element_line(size = 0.5, linetype = "solid", colour = "black"))

genome_prevalence_counts_species %>% 
  filter(Species=="Pk") %>%
  filter(Prevalence!=0) %>% 
ggplot(., aes(x = reorder(Genome, -Prevalence), y = Prevalence)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "ASVs",
    y = "Prevalence",
    title = "ASVs prevalence within Pipistrellus"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_line(size = 0.5, linetype = "solid", colour = "black"))
